card.title: IPad 6 No Display Backlight Repair

claims.statement: iPad 6 backlight: two backlight filters by the LCD connector (under a black sticker) blow if the LCD is connected with the battery attached.
Intermittent or total loss of display/backlight is common on iPad 6 from the 5662 backlight IC failing over time; replacing it fixes it.

procedure: Remove the black sticker and inspect the two filters.
Replace the 5662 backlight IC for intermittent loss.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
